criteria.ac: Loosening guard: with the pre-change `punt-scan.js` saved from the base commit to a temporary path (`git show HEAD:plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/punt-scan.js`, with its two sibling requires alongside), running old and new over every file in `records/specs/` shows, for each file, `new.blocking_open_count >= old.blocking_open_count` and `new.eligible_count >= old.eligible_count`. A rise is expected for the 56 listed-Punt specs and is not a failure; the check exists to catch an accidental loosening of eligibility, which the monotone design forbids. A failure to load the old module or to read a file fails the check; it is never caught and counted as a pass. The permanent encoding of the same property is the per-form equality test, which pins that recognition changes no classification; the guard is the one-off proof over the real corpus.
